headline: Building products from idea to production.
availability: Open to software, backend and applied AI opportunities.

profile.bio: I build Python backends, web and mobile applications, and applied AI workflows. Previously Senior Software Engineer at LII Lab, with 3.5 years of production experience. Now based in Paderborn, Germany, studying M.Sc. Computer Science and building independent software products.
profile.creed_practice: Keep learning. Keep building. A little better every day.

projectPatches.description: Developed the Flutter learning application and Python assessment services for PTE preparation as part of the LII Lab engineering team.
highlights: Built timed practice, audio recording and reusable mock-test workflows.
Connected spoken and written assessment workflows to scoring services.
Implemented purchase verification and transaction deduplication.
Contributed to 93+ production releases across the full November 2022–April 2026 LII Lab tenure.

projectPatches.description: Rebuilt a restaurant’s website around its real operating needs: a clear route from menu to order, confirmations for customers and staff, and a practical initial scope.
highlights: Replaced cluttered navigation with clear routes to the menu, delivery and takeaway.
Connected orders and reservations to customer confirmations, restaurant email and Telegram alerts.
Supported French and English, mobile and desktop, schedule-ahead orders and lunch-hour availability.
Kept the initial scope lean and continued iterating on how customers used the site.
Computed opening status in Paris time.
Loaded the map after explicit consent.
Added LocalBusiness structured data and locale-specific canonical and hreflang links.

experiencePatches.summary: Led backend engineering for OneIELTS and OnePTE at LII Lab.
bullets: Built backend services for assessment, content management and subscriptions.
Implemented tenant isolation, custom domain routing and configurable scoring for a short-lived institute-focused version of OneIELTS.
Integrated speech recognition, pronunciation assessment and NLP services.
Implemented subscription billing across five providers with idempotent payment webhooks.
Added API monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana; reviewed code and supported junior engineers.

experiencePatches.summary: Developed Flutter learning applications and Django assessment services.
bullets: Built practice and mock-test workflows with audio recording, timed progression and score breakdowns.
Connected mobile clients to assessment APIs and implemented purchase verification.
Built question-bank administration and learning analytics.
Contributed to 93+ production releases across the full November 2022–April 2026 LII Lab tenure.

entryPatches.note: Built a document-to-draft workflow linking generated claims to source spans, pages and evidence regions, with parsing, OCR, hybrid retrieval and an evidence-review interface.

entryPatches.learning: Building a working system and explaining its architectural tradeoffs require separate preparation.

newProjects.name: crosspost
newProjects.tagline: Publishing that can resume after partial failure
newProjects.description: A CLI for validating media and publishing to YouTube, Facebook and Instagram, with a per-account ledger for safe retries.
highlights: Validated media and platform requirements before uploading.
Added dry-run previews to inspect the intended publication.
Tracked successful posts so retries can resume without repeating completed uploads.

newExperience.summary: Building and maintaining web products and applied AI tools alongside independent technical education. Client delivery, personal projects and interview take-homes are identified separately in the work below.
bullets: Delivered SushiLab, a bilingual restaurant ordering website, and continued improving its ordering flows.
Built a document-to-draft workflow with source-linked evidence for an AI Engineer take-home.
Built crosspost with media validation, dry-run previews and resumable publishing.

newEntries.title: Extended SushiLab with a pickup-only offer
newEntries.note: Added a localized buy-one-get-one offer to the restaurant ordering flow, keeping pickup eligibility separate from delivery and carrying the offer into cart and order details.
newEntries.learning: A promotion changes more than the menu card. Its rules need to agree across the cart, totals and order details.
